questions.q: In a hire purchase agreement, the legal title (ownership) of the goods strictly passes to the buyer only when...
options: the initial deposit is successfully paid to the seller.
the buyer signs the hire purchase documents.
the final installment payment is completed.
the goods are delivered to the buyer's house.
questions.explain: Under the Hire Purchase Act, the buyer is merely hiring the goods while paying installments. Legal **ownership (title)** remains with the seller and only passes to the buyer upon the payment of the **final installment**.
